note: Every requirement traces to a promise made in the release notes. 'source' names the section. Nothing here is invented: if the notes do not promise it, it is not a requirement.

requirements.title: OMA journal backend
requirements.statement: Provide a RunJournal implementation for @open-multi-agent/core, installable as a dependency and enabled by configuration alone.
requirements.verify: Integration test: journal written through OMA orchestrator

requirements.title: OMA approval-store backend
requirements.statement: Provide an approval-store implementation for OMA so approval requests and decisions enter the same record.
requirements.verify: Integration test: suspend/approve/resume cycle recorded

requirements.title: MCP proxy collector (stdio)
requirements.statement: Intercept agent-to-MCP-server traffic over stdio and record every tool call and result.
requirements.verify: E2E test against a reference MCP server over stdio

requirements.title: MCP proxy collector (HTTP)
requirements.statement: Same capture over HTTP transport.
requirements.source: Getting started — tested against MCP servers over stdio and HTTP
requirements.verify: E2E test against a reference MCP server over HTTP

requirements.title: Digest tool identity and arguments
requirements.statement: Record and digest the tool name and its invocation arguments.
requirements.verify: Red-team attack A fails closed

requirements.title: Digest tool result
requirements.statement: Record and digest the tool result content.
requirements.verify: Red-team attack A fails closed

requirements.title: Digest approval decisions
requirements.statement: Record and digest approval decisions, including the deciding identity as supplied.
requirements.verify: Unit test: decision tamper detected

requirements.title: Predecessor chaining
requirements.statement: Every event carries a cryptographic digest of its predecessor.
requirements.verify: Red-team attacks B, C, F fail closed

requirements.title: Per-leaf salting
requirements.statement: Every leaf is salted with a per-leaf random nonce before hashing.
requirements.verify: Unit test: identical content yields distinct digests

requirements.title: Batch signing with operator key
requirements.statement: Sign each batch root with the operator-supplied key.
requirements.source: Integrity — batches are signed with your key
requirements.verify: Signature verifies under operator public key

requirements.title: Forward-secure epoch ratchet
requirements.statement: Evolve the signing key per epoch and destroy the predecessor so prior entries cannot be re-signed with the current key.
requirements.verify: Test: epoch N key cannot produce a valid epoch N-1 signature

requirements.title: C2SP checkpoint emission
requirements.statement: Emit checkpoints in C2SP tlog-witness conformant format.
requirements.verify: Conformance suite; third-party witness accepts checkpoint

requirements.title: Configurable witness set
requirements.statement: Submit roots to a configurable list of witnesses rather than a single endpoint.
requirements.verify: Config test with 3 witnesses

requirements.title: Rekor witness adapter
requirements.statement: Support Rekor as a witness type.
requirements.verify: Live anchor against Rekor; inclusion proof retrieved

requirements.title: transparency-dev/witness adapter
requirements.statement: Support transparency-dev/witness as a witness type.
requirements.verify: Anchor against a local instance

requirements.title: RFC 3161 TSA adapter
requirements.statement: Support an RFC 3161 timestamp authority as a witness type.
requirements.verify: Timestamp token obtained and verified

requirements.title: Operator-hosted witness adapter
requirements.statement: Support an operator's own internal witness endpoint.
requirements.verify: Self-hosted witness round trip

requirements.title: Splitstick hosted witness adapter
requirements.statement: Support the Splitstick hosted witness.
requirements.verify: Hosted witness round trip

requirements.title: Configurable quorum
requirements.statement: Accept a K-of-N quorum setting governing how many countersignatures a batch requires.
requirements.verify: Verifier rejects a batch below quorum

requirements.title: Configurable anchor cadence
requirements.statement: Accept an anchor_interval setting that determines the mutability window.
requirements.source: Independence — cadence is yours to set
requirements.verify: Observed anchor spacing matches configuration

requirements.title: Soft anchor tier
requirements.statement: Provide a fast anchor tier, default every 10 seconds.
requirements.verify: Timing test

requirements.title: Hard anchor tier
requirements.statement: Provide an optional slow, trust-minimised anchor tier that no company can withdraw.
requirements.verify: Anchor obtained; off unless explicitly enabled

requirements.title: Policy changes as chain events
requirements.statement: Record any change to the witness set or quorum as a timestamped event inside the chain.
requirements.verify: Red-team: policy downgrade is visible in the record

requirements.title: Signed heartbeats
requirements.statement: Emit signed heartbeats into the chain at a configured interval.
requirements.verify: Stopping the collector produces a detectable gap

requirements.title: Build digest in heartbeat
requirements.statement: Each heartbeat carries the collector's build digest.
requirements.verify: Patched binary reports an unrecognised digest

requirements.title: Signed gap declarations
requirements.statement: Allow the operator to record an explicit, signed declaration of a genuinely lost batch so the sequence can recover.
requirements.verify: Sequence resumes after a declared gap without a silent reset

requirements.title: Countersigned gap declarations
requirements.statement: Gap declarations are themselves submitted for countersignature.
requirements.source: Coverage attestation — signed, countersigned statement of absence
requirements.verify: Declaration carries a witness signature

requirements.title: splitstick coverage
requirements.statement: Produce a coverage report over a date range stating the percentage of tool calls captured and proving collector liveness throughout.
requirements.verify: Report output matches injected gaps exactly

requirements.title: splitstick verify
requirements.statement: Verify chain integrity, batch signatures and witness countersignatures from files alone.
requirements.verify: All red-team classes fail closed; baseline passes

requirements.title: Acceptance policy as input
requirements.statement: The verifier takes a caller-supplied acceptance policy naming trusted witness keys and quorum.
requirements.source: Proof — an input, not a hardcoded trust store
requirements.verify: Same pack verifies under two different policies

requirements.title: Evidence pack carries all countersignatures
requirements.statement: Packs include every countersignature collected, not only Splitstick's.
requirements.verify: Pack inspection after multi-witness anchoring

requirements.title: splitstick disclose
requirements.statement: Emit a Merkle inclusion proof for a single named event.
requirements.verify: Recipient verifies one event without the rest

requirements.title: Inclusion proof binds to countersigned root
requirements.statement: Inclusion proofs verify against a countersigned root, not a bare local digest.
requirements.verify: Proof rejected when root is unwitnessed

requirements.title: Optional batch padding
requirements.statement: Provide optional padding of batches to obscure activity volume.
requirements.verify: Anchor volume decoupled from event volume when enabled

requirements.title: Content externalised from the chain
requirements.statement: The chain stores salted commitments and pointers only; content lives in operator-controlled mutable storage.
requirements.source: Erasure — no content is ever in the chain
requirements.verify: Chain inspection contains no plaintext

requirements.title: Crypto-shredding
requirements.statement: Deleting content and its key leaves the chain verifiable and the commitment permanently unlinkable.
requirements.verify: Verify passes after content+key deletion

requirements.title: Retention policy on storage
requirements.statement: Retention and erasure are configurable at the storage layer, independent of the cryptography.
requirements.source: Erasure — policy settings on your storage
requirements.verify: Retention config honoured; chain unaffected

requirements.title: Fail-open with marked batch
requirements.statement: When no witness is reachable, chain and sign locally, mark the batch unwitnessed, and queue it.
requirements.verify: Agent completes with all witnesses unreachable

requirements.title: Late countersignature records real time
requirements.statement: A retroactive countersignature records the witness's actual receipt time, not the batch's claimed time.
requirements.verify: Delta between operator and witness time is present in the record

requirements.title: Late anchors reported as gaps
requirements.statement: Windows anchored late are reported as coverage gaps.
requirements.source: Operations — reported as a coverage gap
requirements.verify: Coverage report flags the widened window

requirements.title: Configuration file
requirements.statement: Support splitstick.yaml with witnesses, quorum, on_unavailable and anchor_interval keys.
requirements.verify: Documented example loads and takes effect

requirements.title: Operator enrolment
requirements.statement: Register an operator identity and public key with a witness so per-operator sequence state can be kept.
requirements.source: Witness Practice Statement — this enrolled operator
requirements.verify: Enrolment then successive anchors tracked

requirements.title: Witness enforces monotonic sequence
requirements.statement: The witness verifies that each submitted root is the immediate successor of the last recorded for that operator.
requirements.verify: Truncation and erasure both detected

requirements.title: Witness retains roots
requirements.statement: The witness keeps submitted roots in its own append-only store.
requirements.source: Witness Practice Statement — has retained it
requirements.verify: Root retrievable from the witness independently

requirements.title: Witness stamps its own clock
requirements.statement: The countersignature carries the witness's own time, not the operator's.
requirements.source: Witness Practice Statement — at this time, per its clock
requirements.verify: Operator-supplied time cannot influence the countersignature

requirements.title: Conformance test suite
requirements.statement: Publish an executable conformance suite any witness implementation can run against itself.
requirements.source: Licence and governance — conformance suite is open
requirements.verify: Suite runs green against the reference witness

requirements.title: Witness list as data
requirements.statement: Maintain the list of known conformant witnesses as a machine-readable file, each entry carrying its acceptable-use terms, rate limits, and whether it retains entries publicly, so an operator chooses on informed grounds rather than by default.
requirements.source: Licence and governance — a plain file in the repository
requirements.verify: File parses; the collector consumes it; every entry states its acceptable-use position
